read.thesis: Cognizant Q3 CY26 is a mixed print: revenue +4.6% with FY26 CC growth guide trimmed to 4.0–4.4%, Q3 bookings down 7%, and Project Leap costs raised to $180–250M, while adjusted margin still expanded 30bp.

triggers.label: Q3 bookings down 7% y/y
triggers.quote: Bookings in the third quarter declined 7% year-over-year.

triggers.label: FY26 CC growth cut to 4.0–4.4%
triggers.quote: 2026 constant currency revenue growth guidance is revised to 4.0% to 4.4% year-over-year growth

triggers.label: Project Leap costs raised to $180–250M
triggers.quote: We now expect to record total costs of $180 million to $250 million

guidance.quote: 2026 constant currency revenue growth guidance is revised to 4.0% to 4.4% year-over-year growth
2026 Adjusted Operating Margin guidance is now approximately 16.1%, year-over-year expansion of 30 basis points
2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance revised to $5.72 to $5.79, year-over-year growth of 8% to 10%
Fourth quarter revenue is expected to be $5.49 to $5.57 billion, growth of 3.0% to 4.5%
We now expect to record total costs of $180 million to $250 million

red_flags.label: Bookings down 7% in Q3
red_flags.quote: Bookings in the third quarter declined 7% year-over-year.

red_flags.label: Adjusted EPS growth trails GAAP-to-adjusted restructuring; Project Leap cost range widened
red_flags.quote: We now expect to record total costs of $180 million to $250 million

red_flags.label: Long-term debt up to $1,552M from $543M; $1.0B revolver draw
